title: Term-Timing Adjustment on Rental Plus Upgrade Charges
content:
How far into the term a Plus upgrade is made adjusts the Rental Property Service Contracts Plus upgrade charge: the term-timing adjustment is set by the days from the term start date to the upgrade.

| Upgrade made | Term-timing adjustment |
|---|---|
| no more than 31 days after the term start date | a credit of 0.05 |
| more than 270 days after the term start date | a loading of 0.03 |
| otherwise | 0 |

The days are the calendar days from the term start date on the contract to the upgrade date.

**How the adjustment acts.** Credits on a Plus upgrade charge are subtracted from one and a loading is added to it, all in one sum, and the charge is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

## Boundaries

| Days after the term start date | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| 31 | credit 0.05 |
| 32 | 0 |
| 270 | 0 |
| 271 | loading 0.03 |

*Hypothetical:* a term starting 1 March and an upgrade on 20 March (19 days in): credit 0.05, so this adjustment alone leaves 0.95 of the charge.
